findings.evidence: Table 26-3 Pattern templates in the library . . . 454 ... Table 26-1 ... 460 ... Table 26-2 ... 465
findings.issue: The List of Tables lists Table 26-3 at p. 454 before Table 26-1 at p. 460 and Table 26-2 at p. 465. That ordering is inconsistent with the sequential numbering used throughout the table list and makes the table index unreliable for locating numbered tables in order.
findings.fix_instruction: Reorder the Chapter 26 entries in the List of Tables so the page numbers and table numbers are consistent, or verify and correct the page references for Tables 26-1 through 26-3.

findings.issue: The copyright page gives bare repository URLs for the operative license without a stable bibliographic citation or a note that the URL is a pointer to the governing text. In a printed/handbook artifact, bare URLs are fragile and can drift; the page also says the LICENSE file is authoritative but does not identify a retrieval date for the URL.
findings.fix_instruction: Add the access/retrieval date for the LICENSE URLs, and consider adding a short 'license pointer' note that the URL is a convenience copy and the pinned commit is the immutable reference.

findings.page: PDF pp. 1–178 (printed pp. 1–154) — Chs. 1–7 through §7.6; PDF pp. 179–547 (printed pp. 155–547) not extractable
findings.evidence: The supplied document exposes an extractable text layer for PDF pages 1–178 only, i.e. front matter (List of Figures pp. iv–vi, List of Tables pp. vii–viii, Preface pp. ix–xix), Parts I–III, Chapters 1–7 up to §7.6 and Figs. 7.5–7.6 (last readable folio = PDF p. 178 = printed p. 154). PDF p. 179 onward returns “[No extractable text layer on this page]”; only four page images were rendered (cover, a blank leaf, PDF p. 61 / printed p. 37 with Fig. 3.1, PDF p. 159 / printed p. 135 with Fig. 7.1). Ch. 8 starts at printed p. 158 (Contents, PDF p. 6), and Chs. 9–26, Appendix A (p. 471), Glossary (p. 504), References (p. 509), Sources, Method, and Reproducibility (p. 512) and The Architecture Worksheet (p. 520) lie entirely outside the readable range.
findings.issue: Not a book defect, but a disclosure the review panel needs: every finding in this report is a verified read of PDF pp. 1–178 only. No assertion here about Chs. 8–26, Appendix A, the Glossary, References, the Sources chapter or the Worksheet is a verified read — those pages were not available as text or image here, and their contents were known only from the Contents and List of Figures/Tables (PDF pp. 6–12).
findings.fix_instruction: Treat this report as covering front matter and Chs. 1–7 only. Re-run the full sweep (cross-references, recurrence, figure-vs-caption, arithmetic) on a text-extractable or OCR'd rendering of PDF pp. 179–547 before drawing any conclusion about Chs. 8–26, Appendix A, Glossary, References, Sources chapter and Worksheet.

findings.evidence: Contents: "I The Token . . . 1" and "1 It All Starts With the First Token . . . 1". The Part I divider is PDF p. 25 (printed p. 1, text "part I. The Token 1") and the Chapter 1 opener is PDF p. 26, whose running head reads "chapter 1. It All Starts With the First Token" with folio "2". Every other entry matches its own opener page: Ch. 2 → 15 (PDF p. 39), Ch. 3 → 35 (PDF p. 59), Ch. 4 → 57 (PDF p. 81), Ch. 7 → 126 (PDF p. 150), and Part II divider 56 → Ch. 4 at 57 (the same one-page divider-to-chapter offset as Part I's 1 → 2).
findings.issue: The Contents pointer for Chapter 1 resolves to the Part I divider page, not to the chapter opener, so it is off by one against the book's own (consistent) pattern for every other chapter and part. A reader following the TOC lands one page before the chapter.
findings.fix_instruction: Set the Contents entry for Chapter 1 to page 2 (leaving "I The Token 1" as the part divider), and re-check the same offset for the remaining part/chapter pairs.

findings.evidence: List of Tables: "Table 26-1 The FACT set to measure for each pattern . . . 460", "Table 26-2 Pattern Instance: Sharded RAG Serving . . . 465", "Table 26-3 Pattern templates in the library . . . 454".
findings.issue: Table ID order does not follow page order: Table 26-3 is placed at printed p. 454, before Table 26-1 (p. 460) and Table 26-2 (p. 465). Either the identifier or the page reference for Table 26-3 is wrong, breaking the book's own sequential numbering convention (which every other list entry follows) and the List-of-Tables promise that "Every table the book numbers" is indexed with a correct page.
findings.fix_instruction: Verify the printed page of "Table 26-3 Pattern templates in the library" and correct either its page reference or its ID so that table numbers increase with page order; re-check the List of Tables after the change.

findings.evidence: "they are not operative in their own right, and the LICENSE file at the pinned commit below governs wherever the two differ" and "The operative licence text is not reproduced in this artifact — the paragraphs above are a plain-language summary — so a reader holding only this file must retrieve the grant from the pinned commit."
findings.issue: The distributed artifact is not self-contained with respect to its own license: the file explicitly states the inline bullets are not operative and that the governing license text exists only in an external repository. A reader holding only this file cannot know the actual redistribution terms of the work, and the 'as is' grant is unverifiable offline.
findings.fix_instruction: Reproduce the full LICENSE text verbatim in the artifact (e.g., as a final appendix or on the copyright pages), keeping the pinned-commit URL as a cross-check rather than as the sole carrier of the operative grant.

findings.evidence: "Full terms: https://github.com/zhiqitao/from-token-to-fleet/blob/27f4cd5/LICENSE" and "raw file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhiqitao/from-token-to-fleet/27f4cd5/LICENSE", while the same page states "This edition is built from commit 27f4cd571d53ecb2ac549d5825a77c87f8736ad3 (short 27f4cd5)".
findings.issue: Both license URLs pin a 7-character abbreviated commit, although the edition elsewhere treats the full 40-character hash as the immutable source revision. Short hashes are not collision-proof and do not survive repository rewrites, so the 'immutable' pin that carries the operative license is weaker than the edition's own pinning standard.
findings.fix_instruction: Replace '27f4cd5' with the full commit hash '27f4cd571d53ecb2ac549d5825a77c87f8736ad3' in both URLs, or state explicitly that the short ref is resolvable to the pinned commit and record the resolution date.

findings.evidence: "Table 2-2 Decode bandwidth and prefill FLOPs … 26" — but the table title "2.3.1. Table 2-2 — Decode bandwidth and prefill FLOPs (worked example, not reference)" is printed on book p. 22 (PDF 46) with body from p. 23. Same defect: "Table 4-2 Canonical-scenario provenance ledger … 75" (title on book p. 71), "Table 7-1 KV cache size per token and per-context arithmetic … 133" (title on book p. 130), "Table 1-1 … 12" (title on book p. 10), "Table 2-1 … 19" (p. 18), "Table 3-1 … 40" (p. 39), "Table 3-2 … 42" (p. 40), "Table 3-3 … 53" (p. 51), "Table 4-1 … 62" (p. 59), "Table 5-2 … 100" (p. 99), "Table 7-2 … 140" (p. 138). Only Table 5-1 (97) and Table 6-1 (120) match.
findings.issue: The List of Tables page references are systematically stale: 11 of the 13 verifiable entries point 1–4 pages past the table's printed start (apparently to the page where the float's last portion lands), while two entries correctly point at the start page. The index cannot be used to locate tables and is internally inconsistent.
findings.fix_instruction: Regenerate the List of Tables against the actual float placement so every entry cites the page on which the table begins, and re-verify after any layout change.

findings.chapter: Front matter (List of Figures / List of Tables)
findings.evidence: "26.2 Pattern Application Diagram. . . . . . . 467" (p. 10) and "Table 2-1 The resource model: seven resources, and the constraint each one names. . . . 19", "Table 3-2 MoE model parameter arithmetic (worked example, not reference). . . . 42" (p. 11) — trailing period glued to the leader dots — vs the spaced form "3.3 Wan2.2 A14B selects experts as the denoising schedule progresses . . . 49" (p. 9).
findings.issue: Leader-dot treatment is inconsistent across the front-matter indexes: entries whose titles end in a period have the period fused to the dot leader with no separating space, while other entries use a spaced leader. Minor typography, but it recurs on both index pages and changes the visual rhythm of the apparatus.
findings.fix_instruction: Normalize the separator between entry text and dot leader (insert the space, or strip the trailing period) across the Contents, List of Figures, and List of Tables.

findings.evidence: P.1 The architect’s decision loop... P.2 Reading the book two ways... 1.1 The KV cache... 1.2 How a token travels
findings.issue: List of Figures contains entries for front matter (P.1, P.2) followed by Chapter 1 figures, but Chapter 4's 'CANONICAL TEACHING MODEL' callout box is heavily referenced throughout the text as an anchor for all numerical proofs. This box (Table 4-2) is the absolute spine of the book's arithmetic. Table 4-2 is listed in List of Tables, but it is not visually distinct enough from standard tables, leading to confusion about whether it's an assumption or derived value.
findings.fix_instruction: In the List of Tables and List of Figures, clearly designate the 'Canonical Workload box' and Table 4-2 as the central anchor reference for all downstream arithmetic.

findings.evidence: You may freely read, study, learn from, and redistribute the work (verbatim, with attribution) for personal and non-commercial ends — no permission needed.
findings.issue: Copyright page plain-language bullets are explicitly 'not operative in their own right, and the LICENSE file at the pinned commit below governs wherever the two differ' yet the page still presents a standalone non-commercial redistribution permission without the LICENSE file's channel-specific terms (e.g., Amazon KDP) or revocation conditions. Reader holding only PDF may rely on bullet as license grant contrary to disclaimer.
findings.fix_instruction: Move the two bullets into a shaded 'Summary only' box with mandatory footer on every chapter: 'Operative license at github.com/zhiqitao/from-token-to-fleet/blob/27f4cd5/LICENSE — this PDF alone does not convey rights.'
